Circuit (original and published circuit.png agree): the 1V source (long plate on top = positive) goes through the top 1Ω and 1H to node X. From X, one branch runs down through S (i_S arrow pointing down) and another runs through 2F and the right 1Ω to the bottom rail. The junction dots at X and on the bottom rail, and all labels (1Ω, 1H, 2F, 1Ω, 1V, S, i_S), are present in the published figure.

Recalculated: for t<0 the capacitor is open, so i_L(0⁻)=0 and V_C(0⁻)=1V (X side high). After closing, V_X=0, so i_L=1−e^{−t} (τ=1 s). The capacitor branch discharges on its own: V_C=e^{−t/2} and i2=C·dV_C/dt=−e^{−t/2}. KCL gives i_S=1+e^{−t/2}−e^{−t}.

i_S(0⁺)=1 A. The slope at t=0 is +0.5 A/s. The maximum is at t=2ln2≈1.386 s with i_S=1.25 A. e^{−t/2}−e^{−t}=e^{−t/2}(1−e^{−t/2})≥0, so i_S≥1 at all times. After the peak the current decreases monotonically to 1 A.

The published choice figures choice-1 to choice-5 match the original choice waveforms: the (n) labels, axes i_S[A] and t[s], the reference 1, the dashed lines and the t<0 zero lines are all present. The text descriptions of each choice waveform also match the figures.
The reasons given for each wrong choice are correct: (1) contradicts i_S≥1, (2) and (4) contradict i_S(0⁺)=1, and (5) contradicts the existence of the peak.

explanationIssues: The note at the end says expressions using E cannot match dimensionally because the plate spacing d is not given. This reasoning is wrong. eE is a force [N] and has the wrong dimension for energy regardless of whether d is known. Rewrite the note to say that eE [N] is not energy [J] (and that eEd=eV).

Choice explanation (4) has the same problem: 「本問にdの情報はなく、この組合せは次元的に不適切」 gives the lack of d as a reason for the dimensional mismatch, which is wrong. For (イ), also note that eE/m is an acceleration [m/s²], so √(2eE/m) does not have units of speed. The cause of the error should be limited to dimensions.
